phase_prompt.label: Phase 3: Eternal Judgment
phase_prompt.summary: The process stabilizes into a permanent state of suffering. They are heaps of molten code, forever burning and freezing, trapped in the secret archives of the simulation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A low-angle, tragic shot of the Judged Angels reduced to huddled masses of cooling obsidian and weeping plasma. They are fused to the ground, their wings heavy and useless slabs of dark rock. The lighting is minimal, picking out the wet sheen of the melting material in the darkness. The scene conveys a sense of eternal, silent weight, with heat shimmers distorting the air around them, rendered with absolute physical fidelity to texture and light.
